display.title: Episode 11: The Lost Letter, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: A new serial begins: a wealthy student tells the dying Baal Shem Tov he needs no blessing, and is given a sealed letter to deliver, which he loses. Plus listeners' letters and a contest.
display.summary_long: After a grand march, story time begins a new serial, "The Lost Letter". In the Baal Shem Tov's last days, he calls each student to his bedside to bless him. Reb Leibel, the richest man in town, generous with tzedakah and blessed with a healthy family, decides he needs no bracha, a big mistake, since the wheel of fortune always turns, which is why we daven every day. Halfway through, a young club member leads the Shema. When Reb Leibel says he needs nothing, the Baal Shem Tov asks him for a favor instead: to deliver a sealed letter to Reb Sholom, for his eyes only. Riding home through a fierce rainstorm, Reb Leibel bends to pull off his muddy boots, and the envelope slips away; strangely, he forgets all about it. Chapter 2 is next week. The mailbox has a girl who wants a Tzivos Hashem T-shirt for a poor friend in Eretz Yisroel, and several children asking for the words of the theme song "We Want Moshiach Now". Uncle Yossi announces a contest, running until Purim, for a letter, poem or drawing, with a set of 28 story tapes as the prize.
display.lesson: However well things are going, keep asking Hashem and the tzaddikim for blessing, because no one knows what tomorrow will bring.
